description: This file defines a Java class 'Digraph' which implements a basic utility for directed graphs, including construction from a map and topological sorting methods.

classes.name: Digraph
classes.description: A generic class representing a directed graph with methods for constructing the graph and performing topological sorts. Parameterized by node type T.

methods.name: Digraph
methods.description: Constructor that creates a directed graph from a map of source nodes to collections of target nodes, ensuring all nodes are declared.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Performs a topological sort assuming the graph is acyclic, returning a linear ordering of nodes.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Private helper method for conducting depth-first search to assist with topological sorting, detecting cycles.
